# Coding Harness v1 deterministic fixtures

These files are inert repository content used by UAT jobs. They are never executable authority.
Validation can run only a node-operator-owned profile. Each fixture contains one deterministic
arithmetic defect (`+ 1`) whose approved repair is `+ 2`.

- `rust/src/lib.rs` exercises compiled source edits.
- `python/calculator.py` exercises interpreted source edits.
- `javascript/calculator.js` exercises JavaScript source edits.
